chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Validity of IEC for EOUs / SEZs
text: 2.11 Validity of IEC for EOUs / SEZs An IEC will remain valid irrespective of a firm’s status as a DTA unit or an SEZ unit or an EOU/EHTP/STP/BTP unit.
intent: Provide knowledge guidance for Validity of IEC for EOUs / SEZs.
